ctx.x: When did you start playing with any regularity anywhere? Was it during this period?

From the age of 6 until I was 14 I was all over the city playing. I played for the Mellons. I became the little piano girl of East Liberty and anytime anybody was having a party or anything they'd say, "Well, let's get the little piano girl." So by this time I was among nothing but the wealthy people of Pittsburgh, playing for their parties. The chauffeur would pick me up or my stepfather, Fletcher Burley, would take me. He would take me to parties like for the Mellons and my brother-in-law, Hugh Floyd, would…
So you were getting real training?
